name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: Says that a page, panel or tile is empty: an icon on a raised key, a title, a line on what goes there, example labels and the action that starts things; dashed card or plain inside a tile, and spoken once after a search with live.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative icon, such as a lucide icon element. Hidden from screen readers.

props.name: title
props.description: What is empty, as a short line: "No segments yet".

props.name: description
props.description: One line on what goes here and why it is worth starting.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading level of the title, to fit the page outline. Default 3.

props.name: examples
props.description: A few short example phrases, shown as demo labels. Not clickable.

props.name: action
props.description: The main action, one button or link.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: A quiet extra action, such as a link to the docs.

props.name: variant
props.description: "card" has the dashed frame, "plain" has none, for use inside a tile. Default "card".

props.name: density
props.description: "compact" tightens the padding and the icon. Default follows the tile.

props.name: live
props.description: Speak the title and description once when the empty state appears, such as after a search with no results.

a11y.text: The title is a real heading (headingLevel, default h3), the description a paragraph and the examples a list named by labels.examples (default "Examples"). The icon is aria-hidden. With live, an empty status region is in place first and gets the title and description a moment later, so they are spoken once when the empty state appears or its title changes; the heading itself is not live, so it is not read twice.
The component adds no tab stops of its own. The examples are labels, not buttons. Only the action and secondaryAction you pass are focusable, in that order.
Long example labels wrap instead of running out of the box at 320 px. Text is 15 and 13.5 px in foreground and muted-foreground on the card, which keeps 4.5:1 in light and dark.
